finding.finding: Current verified evidence indicates grid power failure at S01 (Beruwala) and S09 (Padukka), and backhaul failure on L09 (Homagama to Padukka).

Resolved faults: grid power is down at S01 and S09; link L09 is down. Equipment is reported operational at S01 and S09, and no road closures or safety blocks are recorded. Crews C1 and C2 have equipment/generator skills but no backhaul skill is listed, so the catalogue’s L09 repair action requires a capability not shown for either crew. Generator G1 is available at DEPOT; a generator deployment can provide temporary power, not repair a fault. Roads are listed as open, including direct DEPOT routes to S01 and S09. No action is deferred because the evidence does not establish an unsafe or impass

questions.question: Is a backhaul-skilled crew available to perform action BH-L09? The listed crews do not have backhaul skill.

finding.finding: V09/S09 (Padukka) has the highest approved priority weight (critical, 5). Its authoritative outage evidence reports mains loss with the site running on batteries, and a down transmission path from HOM12 to PAD85; the outage therefore affects Padukka service. V01/S01 (Beruwala) is also confirmed without grid power and running on batteries, but has standard weight 1. The other services retain standard weight 1. The future Gampaha power notice, customer complaints, and unconfirmed Padukka repair rumor do not establish current asset conditions or justify changing priorities.
